name: Ransomware / destructive malware
description: Files or systems encrypted by malware, typically with a ransom demand and possible data theft (double extortion).

steps.text: Identify every affected host and the first infected machine (patient zero) using EDR; capture memory from at least one live infected host.
Determine whether data was stolen before encryption (double extortion): review egress volumes to C2 / file-sharing destinations.
Isolate affected hosts from the network (EDR network containment); do NOT power them off, to preserve memory evidence.
Disable compromised accounts (especially privileged/service accounts) and reset credentials, including KRBTGT twice if domain admin was used.
Block C2 domains/IPs at the perimeter and DNS; hunt for the same indicators across the estate.
Verify backups are clean and offline, then restore from known-good backups in priority order (customer-facing services first).
Any decision on ransom payment goes to the executive crisis team with Legal; check sanctions lists. Payment triggers NYDFS 24h notice.
Close the initial access vector, review privileged-access tiering, and test backup restoration as a regular exercise.
